summary: Procure Loom enterprise seats for Customer Engagement with Okta SSO and 12-month retention
description: Request to procure 120 Loom Enterprise seats for the Customer Engagement org to support async demo creation, customer onboarding videos, and internal enablement. Must include Okta SSO + SCIM provisioning, audit log export to Splunk, and a 12-month video retention policy. Procurement should include pricing breakdown for annual commitment and a month-to-month option for the first quarter as a pilot.
impact: Customer-facing teams (Customer Engagement, Solutions Engineering, and Onboarding) are unable to scale async demo creation; delays increase time-to-first-value for new customers. Current workaround (one-off personal accounts) causes security and audit gaps.
procurement_reason: Scale video demos and onboarding content for new customers; consolidate disparate personal accounts into managed enterprise seats with SSO and auditability.
estimated_monthly_cost: $3,600 (estimated for annual plan) — vendor provided ballpark; awaiting formal quote
required_integrations: Audit log export to Splunk (JSON events)
GDrive upload for team assets optional
security_notes: Security requested confirmation of audit log delivery format and retention controls. Must ensure video links do not leak outside company/guest lists and that SCIM deprovisioning occurs within 24 hours of Okta deactivation.
procurement_notes: Finance needs vendor SAM and W9. Requester asked for both annual and quarterly billing scenarios. Ask vendor for EDU/nonprofit discounts (not applicable but requested).

2026-03-11 Samir Patel: Acknowledged. Started vendor outreach to Loom account team; asked for enterprise product brief and SOC2 attestation.
2026-03-12 Security (Priya Kapoor): Can Loom provide structured audit logs via webhook or S3 export? Also requesting data retention controls and admin role granularity.
2026-03-12 Samir Patel: Loom rep replied — supports SCIM/Okta, SSO, and audit logs export via Admin API (JSON). Vendor offered an estimated annual price; awaiting written quote and SOC2 docs.
